How to play
Let\'s play the Word Wheel! Choose the right answer for each clue. If you get it right it turns green, and if not it turns red. Good luck!
It\'s Bingo time! Tap the picture that matches what I say. If you get it wrong, you can try again until you have them all.
In this game you need to memorise the icons before they are hidden. Then you will have to remember where the one I ask for was. Be quick!
Let\'s do some old sayings! I say the first part and you choose how it ends. I\'m sure you know them all.
